method: Same saved 32768/98304 token arrays and one-token cold requests as SYCL. F16 KV, MTP3, draft ubatch512, context114688. Warmup4096. No simultaneous build during timed requests. GPU counter sampling uses a configured 5-second sleep; collecting counters adds time.
limitations: Whole configurations differ: backend, KV type, microbatch and compiler; no isolated stock-Vulkan comparison
Only one timing per completed arm/length; no confidence interval
ubatch256 96K was interrupted to prioritize the larger microbatch
ubatch4096 second repetition was interrupted after one complete 32K/96K pair because it was slower
Memory observations are samples, not instrumented peaks or proof about WDDM paging
No Vulkan operator timeline was collected; reason for remaining gap is not established

memory.sampling_covers: Subset of intervals during this PID lifetime; warmup, full request windows and instantaneous peaks are not guaranteed to be covered
